In patients with normal renal function the half-life is about 2.5 to 4.5 hours after intravenous doses and about 4 to 5.7 hours after oral doses. In patients with renal impairment, the renal clearance decreases and the half-life increases; a half-life of 28.5 hours has been re- ported when the serum-creatinine concentration was greater than 398 micromol/litre.
